description: Returns one loan's monthly reports back to its first filing (late 2016 at the earliest): balance, payment status, special servicing, workout strategy, modification, coverage and occupancy. Use it to see how a loan reached its current state. Without a paid cmbs.news plan it returns a plan notice; the loan page on cmbs.news shows the last six months.

slug.description: The loan slug: the last part of its cmbs.news URL, from search_loans

name: get_loan_history
title: Full monthly history of a loan
